`139-139`: ** Trivial** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Assert the source label height, not only its position.** The `fits` check tests only the label's top edge and whether its geometry lies inside its parent. A label shorter than its wrapped text still passes both tests, so the regression test cannot detect clipped text. The test name, `updateChannelHelpReservesItsHeightAfterItAppears`, states that height reservation is the property under test. Add a height check at the label's actual width. Other tests in this file already use this check (for example, `tests/gui/test_settings.cpp:2342`).
Suggested change
```diff - const auto fits=[&]{return source->mapTo(&window,QPoint()).y()>=channel->mapTo(&window,QPoint(0,channel->height())).y()&&source->parentWidget()->rect().contains(source->geometry());}; + const auto fits=[&]{return source->mapTo(&window,QPoint()).y()>=channel->mapTo(&window,QPoint(0,channel->height())).y()&&source->parentWidget()->rect().contains(source->geometry())&&source->height()>=source->heightForWidth(source->width());}; ```
